verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a DIY state backend that stores state in an object store the user manages (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, Google Cloud Storage), and its pricing page lists self-hosting. Together these let users control where their state data lives, although self-hosting is reportedly Enterprise-only. There is no evidence of explicit region or residency selection for the managed Pulumi Cloud backend, so residency control comes only from running your own storage or hosting. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection for Pulumi Cloud, residency guarantees or compliance documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.
